|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Baylan Skoll]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee repository image of this original state. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Baylan Skoll (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 1, file created 10 August 2025: “Once per game, may ▼ a card with 'mercenary' in lore (or a lightsaber on Baylan). While in battle alone or with Shin, unless Sidious on table, opponent must have two characters (or Anakin or Yoda) in battle to draw battle destiny. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Baylan Skoll]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Baylan Skoll]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Baylan Skoll”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
